definition: Deep image prior is a type of convolutional neural network used to enhance a given image with no prior training data other than the image itself.
details: A neural network is randomly initialized and used as prior to solve inverse problems such as noise reduction, super-resolution, and inpainting. Image statistics are captured by the structure of a convolutional image generator rather than by any previously learned capabilities.
story: Picture a child pointing at pictures in a book — cat, car, cloud — learning to see by seeing a thousand examples. In plain words: Deep image prior is a type of convolutional neural network used to enhance a given image with no prior training data other than the image itself. Here is how it actually plays out: A neural network is randomly initialized and used as prior to solve inverse problems such as noise reduction, super-resolution, and inpainting. It is eyes made of arithmetic — pixels become edges, edges become shapes, shapes become meaning. That pixel-to-meaning climb is Deep image prior.
